note: Loess-hill prairie in two tracts along Highway 275, with Interstate 29 running alongside. Camping is at the small gravel parking lot at the foot of each tract, both marked by MDC as primitive camping areas; this is the southern one. No pads, tables or toilets, and no open fires. Steep prairie ridges rise behind. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: lot camping that MDC designates (map Primitive Camping Area symbol beside each of the two Parking Lot squares; a GIS camping point at each; brochure 'only in areas identified on area map') - stays under the Lick Creek reading of the lot rule, flagged for the owner. Pin on the south lot. Phone matches. No split.
flags: LOT RULE - STAYS, OWNER TO CONFIRM: the brochure says 'Primitive Camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map.' and 'No open fires.' The 06/13 map shows one Parking Lot square with a Primitive Camping Area symbol at the foot of each tract, and GIS layer 27 has a point by each: 250 at 40.54924,-95.62453 (lot 1304, 16 m) and 251 at 40.56049,-95.63376 (lot 1, 40 m). On imagery the south one is a gravel pad about 35 x 18 m at the end of a 60 m gravel drive off Highway 275, next to a private house; the north one a gravel pad about 30 x 12 m immediately beside Highway 275. Both points fall on mown grass at the lot's edge. Neither shows pads, rings or tables, and both are 100-200 m from the Interstate 29 lanes. Designated points at the lots keep it; they are lots and nothing more.
PIN: stored 40.54924,-95.62453 is the south lot's GIS camping point, at the edge of the gravel. No move. The south lot is set back from the highway and is the better of the two.
NO SPLIT: the north lot is 1.5 km away at its own turn-off but is a single small lot. Nothing else in the database within 2.5 km.

ACCESS: both lots are straight off paved Highway 275; no posted limit or 4WD wording on the page, brochure or map. Page: 'Services roads on this area are closed to bicycle use year-round' (no bearing on the lots).
PHONE: stored 816-271-3100 matches the page's 'For more information call (816) 271-3100'.
Stored year_round (manual) stands; nothing on the page or brochure limits camping by season.
